title: Pattern Watchlist Entry
description: Patterns detected but below confidence floor (0.5) for execution. Held for observation with optional promotion if confidence improves.

evidence_bundle.description: Evidence from pattern detector (indicator values, thresholds)

timestamp.description: When the pattern was detected and added to watchlist

status.description: WATCHING=active observation, PROMOTED=confidence improved to >=0.5 and sent to execution, EXPIRED=TTL exceeded without promotion, INVALIDATED=pattern structure broke

ttl_hours.description: Time-to-live in hours before automatic expiration (default 72h)

promotion_threshold.description: Confidence level required for promotion to execution

recheck_interval_hours.description: How often to re-evaluate pattern confidence

recheck_count.description: Number of times confidence has been rechecked

confidence_history.description: History of confidence scores at each recheck

notes.description: Optional notes about why pattern is on watchlist
